moments.author: Lane Kiffin
moments.quote: Their fans were elite. That was the loudest, most affected I’ve seen a team be by a crowd in my career.
moments.why: Because Kiffin—often a lightning rod—publicly praised an opponent’s crowd after a hostile reception, fueling major buzz among college‑football fans.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: SFT is more like getting a haircut with a chainsaw than it is “fine‑tuning”! ... FSD V15 goes to wide release next month. It will be something special.
moments.why: Tech and auto crowds are buzzing — Musk’s chainsaw metaphor and FSD V15 tease are provocatively Muskian and trending fast.
